observations: body L1-L9: Ya‘qūb ibn Ṭāriq's table is set with each piece placed as printed: the head in the small type of the notes (x-height 4.4 pt, against 4.9 pt in the rows), «dist minima» without a full stop and «dist. maxima» with it; the whole numbers on their right edges, the fractions from their left edges. The 0 of «20/21» (L3) prints broken, like a closing parenthesis, and the strokes of several fractions print broken. The numbers check: each least distance is the greatest distance of the planet below with its diameter added (56 4/21 + 4 16/21 = 60 20/21, 251 9/21 + 4 16/21 = 256 4/21, 1095 5/21 + 19 1/21 = 1114 6/21, 2104 16/21 + 19 1/21 = 2123 17/21, 8000 + 19 1/21 = 8019 1/21, 13714 6/21 + 19 1/21 = 13733 7/21), the rule of p. 287, L29-L30.

body L10-L17: «al–Bīrūnī», «Ptolemaeus» and «Indorum» are letter-spaced; «al–manshūrāt» (L11) has a long dash (5.4 pt), and the dash before «Sed» (L13) measures 9.8 pt. The o of «exterioris» (L17) did not print; a gap of its width (5.3 pt) stands in its place.
body L18-L26: «al–Bī-rūnī», divided between L18 and L19, «Ptolemaeus» and «Ptolemaei» are letter-spaced; «al–manshūrāt» has long dashes (5.3 and 5.2 pt) in L18 and L24.

body L27-L35: «Ibn Hibintà» (L27), «al–Battānī» (L28, L33) and «Ptolemaeus» are letter-spaced; «Ibn Hibintà» (L28) is not. The long dashes of «al–Battānī» (L28), «4–8», «as–Suhà» (L31), «al–Battānī» (L33), «ar–Raqqah» and «as–Suhà» (L35) measure 5.3, 5.4, 5.3, 5.3, 5.4 and 5.3 pt; the dash before «Sed» (L32) 9.7 pt. Ptolemy's sizes as reported fall by 16 Earths an order, from 96 to 16 for the sixth (96 − 5 · 16 = 16), al-Battānī's by 18, from 108 to 18; the translation, p. 123, l. 4-8, gives al-Battānī's fifteen stars of the first magnitude about 105 times the Earth (Plato 102) and the sixth order 16 times. The year 295 of the Hiǵrah began on 12 October 907 (Julian, by the tabular calendar).
body L18: a third mention of the Kitāb al-manshūrāt, in Barhebraeus, is given in Nallino's addenda et emendanda in Part II (pp. XXV-XXVII), recorded on p. 289 (L29-L33).

notes_left L1-L6: the end of note 11 of p. 287: «ney», the end of «Whitney», is letter-spaced. In the Sūrya-Siddhānta (XII, 84-90, with I, 59) the orbit of the Moon is 324000 yojanas and the diameter of the Earth 1600 yojanas, so that the Moon stands 324000 : 2π = 51566 yojanas, 32.2 diameters of the Earth, from its centre, as printed.

notes_right L1-L5: the Arabic of note 2, «وقد وضعنا ذلك في جدول بحسب راي بطلميوس ووجوده اذ لم يتقرر عندنا راي غيره الى هذه الغاية», ‘we have put this in a table according to the opinion and the finding of Ptolemy, since no other opinion has been established with us up to this point’, is the original of body L24-L26; it begins at the right of the first line, after «(2)», and runs on at the left of the second, followed by «. Sequitur». The rule over the notes and the rule between the two columns print faint and broken.
notes_right L6-L9: as-Suhà is the faint star Alcor, beside ζ Ursae maioris. A stroke stands over the s of «maioris»; «aṣ-Ṣūfī» is letter-spaced, with a hyphen (3.4 pt).
